value.title: Do You Think You Are Worthy of Being My Princess?
value.synopsis: Yunxi Qian is torn from her mountain to marry the Prince of Ye to replace her sister Yunshang. However, she is far from an ordinary princess...

value.title: Zimo Enters the Scene
value.synopsis: Since her marriage, Yunxi's life remains hectic, especially with meeting Zimo Yu. Someone else is feeling lonely in the palace, will she make a friend?

value.title: Domestic Violence?
value.synopsis: Worried about Xue and Que’er, her former maids, Yunxi decides to leave the palace, in disguise, to see them.

value.title: Rally and Chaos
value.synopsis: Yunxi finally relaxes, in the restaurant la Fée drunk, but her respite is short-lived: she must now rescue the boss!

value.title: Intelligent Jun Yiqing
value.synopsis: Prince Ye still suspects his wife of being in Aotian's service. When he goes to find her near Prince Yu, he confesses that he does not know where she is...

value.title: Xue's Temptation
value.synopsis: Yunxi finds out that Xue is being abused, and Que’er has been kicked out of the palace. She tries to find her father to discuss it with him, but the surveillance has been increased: a large banquet is organized to welcome a special guest.

value.title: The Domineering Prince of Ye Saves His Wife
value.synopsis: Still disguised as a servant, Yunxi faces her sister Yunshang. The latter takes advantage that no one recognizes Yunxi to take revenge.

value.title: We Feel Good, When We Are Tsundere
value.synopsis: Back in Ye's palace, Yunxi is not at the end of her sentence. Chu, Ye's favorite concubine, is neglected, and takes a grudge against the princess, whom she considers to be the cause of her misfortunes.

value.title: An Abnormal Prince of Ye?
value.synopsis: Yunxi is taken in spite of herself by Prince Ye out of the palace. What else does fate have in store for her?

value.title: Princess of Ye
value.synopsis: While the party is in full swing, Aotian Qian and Beitang Lie take the opportunity to try to carry out their plan. But Prince Ye does not intend to let it go...

value.title: A Stunning Princess!
value.synopsis: Yunxi managed to "save" the Lanshuang Festival, with the help of Prince Ye. Will they be able to get closer and better understand each other?

value.title: Tasks and Status
value.synopsis: Yunxi argues again with Lady Chu and alienates Prince Ye. How is she going to get out of this mess?

value.title: A Dawning Love
value.synopsis: Yunxi, in search of finding the prince's ring, must get closer to him. Ye takes the opportunity to kiss her ... and ends up discovering his true identity!

value.title: Follow Me, I Run Away From You, Run Away From Me, I Follow You!
value.synopsis: Yunxi tries by all means to get rid of Prince Ye who has become way too clingy. The princely couple are attacked by a demon, who seems to know a lot about Youming Ye...

value.title: Love in the Air
value.synopsis: Seriously injured after the fight, the prince enters a period of convalescence, during which he strengthens his bonds with Yunxi. It seems he can now see the spirits! Dame Chu, jealous of the situation, seems to have an idea in mind to take revenge on the princess...

value.title: Exorcism and Married Life
value.synopsis: Lady Chu takes advantage of the prince's absence to bring the Taoist priest Meihai to the pavilion of serenity, in order to exorcise the demons. Yunxi protects her friends, and the prince his wife when the latter is about to be kidnapped by Meihai.
